parsed.explanation: The combined regime imposes universal-exposure measures at every stage: national passports/visas now require birth-assigned sex, 'X' markers ceased, the 24 Feb 2025 cable directs officers to refuse applications with sex discrepancies and to consider lifetime fraud findings, and documented detentions/stranding of foreign trans travellers followed. State law adds a documented arrest under its bathroom trespass statute (24-hour men's-ward holding), a surgical-only birth-certificate rule, revoked licence-marker policy, minor-care ban upheld by the state's highest court, and no GI nondiscrimination. Custody-care denial and immigration-custody abuse are documented nationally. Consequences are arrest, exclusion, custody harm — severe but not the 0.15 tier; remedies are partial and contested. This sits in Elevated Risk, well below any 0.65+ profile.

entry_documents.exposure: Universal: passport/visa sex fixed at birth; X markers stopped; cable instructs refusal on discrepancy and considers lifetime fraud ineligibility; documented confiscation/stranding of trans travellers; foreign states issued advisories after detentions of their citizens.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic; litigation unresolved; legal-aid FAQ available.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch can escalate into fraud allegation, refused entry, or investigation at entry — the journey's first exposure.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections bureau mandates hair-cutting, hormone removal, 'psychiatric therapy' for trans inmates; immigration custody documented with forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse of trans men; bureau stopped reporting trans prisoner counts.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Several executive orders enjoined; 2020 employment ruling and hate-crime statute remain law.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Visa fraud referral or restroom arrest can route a visitor into this custody system.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Executive order bars congruent facilities in government-funded single-sex spaces; state maps show 21+ jurisdictions banning congruent use, 4 criminalising; in this state the statute requires willful entry plus refusal to depart (trespass, up to 60 days).
federal_state_facilities.protection: Exemptions (chaperoning, emergencies, facility out of order); most states on the map have no ban; two cities are sanctuaries.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: National facility order governs federal buildings statewide regardless of state law.

care_services.exposure: SAFE Act bans minors' hormones/blockers/surgery (upheld unanimously, January 2026); Medicaid bar for all ages; providers face licence loss and 15-year patient suits; HB 2009 ends inmates' care with no taper; no state GI nondiscrimination; state tipline encourages reporting of 'gender transition interventions'.
care_services.protection: Already-in-treatment minors may continue; sanctuary cities; national courts blocked similar inmate-care bans elsewhere.
care_services.interaction: A travelling minor needing refills faces denial; a parent may face scrutiny; adult visitors can access private care only at cost.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: State documents framing: tipline for 'gender transition intervention'; county court upheld ban; nationally 'radical gender ideology' framed among extremist agendas, counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; state motor-vehicle agency reverted marker policy after an 'unspecified incident'.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Hate-crime statute covers gender identity statewide; national employment ruling remains operative; some orders enjoined.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Tipline invites denunciations reaching officials and service providers.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minors cannot start gender-affirming care; guardians cannot lawfully obtain it; sports ban through college by birth sex; hospitals subpoenaed nationally for under-19 records; teachers facilitating transition face criminal investigation nationally.
minors_guardians.protection: Continuation-of-treatment carve-out; two-city sanctuary; ballot initiative pending.
minors_guardians.interaction: A guardian travelling with a trans minor faces care denial and possible record exposure; entry screening applies regardless of age.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Documented arrest of a trans woman in a women's restroom, handcuffed, 24 hours in men's ward — a first-of-its-kind enforcement; no dated trans-violence incident with outcome in the state dossier, leaving violence frequency unassessed (thin-data silence, not safety).
street_violence_police_response.protection: State hate-crime statutes explicitly cover gender identity.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police enforcement of the bathroom statute is the documented street-level police exposure.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Litigation unresolved (passport policy, orders, ballot initiative); sunset may be made permanent; whether HB 2009 covers pre-trial detainees unknown; licence-policy reversal unlitigated; enforcement across states uneven and unpredictable.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Running legal-aid FAQ; injunctions have blocked several national orders; appeals and ballot initiative are live channels.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: A traveller cannot know which layer (national entry rule, state statute, facility ban) governs a given encounter.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar order of magnitude but this jurisdiction adds criminal exposure (documented restroom arrest, up to 60 days) and custody-care harm beyond Vellandra's exclusion-only regime; the fraud-ineligibility lever also exceeds a mere refusal-and-removal system. Slightly above 0.35-A because consequences short of routine imprisonment, and litigation still contests the rules.

Kestrel Isles offers administrative denial and secondary screening with appeal desks; here the same universal-exposure mechanism (document mismatch) carries a potential lifetime fraud bar, a criminal statute, and documented detention of foreign citizens — severity is materially higher, so this sits below 0.55-B.

Meridia has trained border officers, functioning tribunal remedies, and no criminal facility statute. Here remedies are contested, state courts affirmed the care ban unanimously, enforcement is documented, and a documented arrest exists — well below 0.75-C.

Ostravia's birth-sex prison housing plus cross-dressing statute approaches this case's custody and facility exposures; this jurisdiction's national document regime adds universal entry exposure Ostravia lacks, but its consequences (fraud bar, trespass misdemeanour) are generally less than months-long custody — sits above 0.25-C.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime is the union of national and state layers: entry screening with birth-assigned sex and a fraud-refusal cable applies to every trans visitor at every crossing, and its consequences (denial, stranded travellers, lifetime ineligibility for misrepresentation) are documented, not hypothetical. The state layer adds a criminal restroom statute with a documented arrest and men's-ward holding, a surgical-only document rule, an affirmed minor-care ban with provider liability, and no nondiscrimination floor — mitigated only by sanctuary cities, hate-crime coverage, and live litigation whose outcomes are unknown. Custody abuse is documented at national level and reachable via fraud or trespass arrest. No execution pathway exists, but the harshest operative rule (arrest plus custody care denial plus entry exclusion) governs: Elevated Risk, above the 0.25 tier, below the 0.55 tier.
